title: Meta-Complexity & Quantitative Incompressibility Blueprint
description: A 10-node Lean 4 Blueprint DAG establishing finite pigeonhole, bijection cardinality, finite counting algebra (complement, monotonicity, union bound), Kolmogorov incompressibility, and the exponential c-bit incompressibility density theorem underlying Liu-Pass OWF meta-complexity.

tasks.title: Finite pigeonhole: no injection Fin n -> Fin m (m < n)
tasks.description: Prove MetaComplexity.no_inj_lt in MetaComplexity/Pigeonhole.lean with 0 sorry and 0 custom axioms.

tasks.title: Lossless compressor encoding is injective
tasks.description: Prove MetaComplexity.encode_injective_of_lossless in MetaComplexity/DecoderInjective.lean with 0 sorry and 0 custom axioms.

tasks.title: Finite bijection implies equal cardinality
tasks.description: Use pigeonhole_fin to prove MetaComplexity.bij_card_eq: any mutual-inverse pair between Fin n and Fin m implies n = m.

tasks.title: Kolmogorov incompressibility (no universal k < n compressor)
tasks.description: Combine pigeonhole_fin and decoder_injective to prove MetaComplexity.no_universal_lossless_compressor.

tasks.title: Every shorter decoder misses an incompressible witness
tasks.description: Prove MetaComplexity.exists_incompressible_string: for any U : Fin (2^k) -> Fin (2^n) with k < n, there exists x not in the image of U.

tasks.title: Quantitative incompressibility density (>= n - m strings)
tasks.description: Prove MetaComplexity.count_not_in_image_ge: for any decoder U : Fin m -> Fin n, at least n - m strings lie outside the image of U (>= 50% density for 1-bit compression).

tasks.title: Complement partition of finite counts
tasks.description: Prove MetaComplexity.count_add_complement: countFin n P + countFin n (!P) = n for every boolean predicate on Fin n.

tasks.title: Monotonicity of finite predicate counting
tasks.description: Prove MetaComplexity.count_le_of_imp: pointwise implication P -> Q implies countFin n P <= countFin n Q.

tasks.title: Finite probability union bound (countFin)
tasks.description: Prove MetaComplexity.count_or_le_add: countFin n (P || Q) <= countFin n P + countFin n Q.

tasks.title: Exponential c-bit incompressibility theorem
tasks.description: Combine incompressible_density and count_complement_sum to prove that any c-bit compressor leaves at least (2^c - 1)*2^(n-c) incompressible strings and covers at most 2^(n-c).
